title: Boolean-Blind Extraction via a Reset Form Oracle
learning_objectives: Spot a boolean oracle hiding in a response header when the body is uniform
Turn account enumeration into a general truth-value oracle via SQL injection
Extract a secret character-by-character with a binary search over an ASCII-sorted charset
Explain why a constant response body does not make an endpoint enumeration-safe
flag_hint: Recover the 32-char prefix of admin.password_hash through the blind oracle, then POST /solve {"prefix":"..."} to receive the flag read from $FLAG_PATH.
inspired_by: PortSwigger 'Blind SQL injection with conditional responses' + the username-enumeration-via-response-difference report family
